command_lines.line: The skill file doesn't match the answers you gave me. This version of `/craft:tidy-followups` is read-only and has only six steps. It has no step 8 (shortlist moves), no disposition-set question and no step 11 (scope confirmation), and it never sends out refinement subagents. So none of those three questions came up, and I didn't use your answers or send any subagents to the fixture repo.
